title: Tsukiji, Kamakura, then Yokohama
summary: Tsukiji for breakfast, then Kamakura: pancakes in Hase, Hase-dera and the Great Buddha. Yokohama from the afternoon: shopping at Queen's Square and Landmark Plaza, the Air Cabin, the Vanish coaster, the ferris wheel at sunset, the Red Brick Warehouses at dusk, dinner in Chinatown and a foot massage.
